project_name: THE AI WEB TOOLS LEGION OF BOTS

typography.instructions: Use Chivo for high-impact headers (H1-H3). Use IBM Plex Sans for long-form reading and chat messages. Use JetBrains Mono for system signals, metadata, bot names, code blocks, and the 'MORE AI TOOLS' button to give a terminal feel.

colors.instructions: Emulate 'aiwebtools.app' with a deep void canvas (almost black). The primary color MUST be a piercing Matrix green. Use primary_muted for active states backgrounds and selection.

visual_enhancers.retro_futurism: Apply the 'Terminal Look'. Interfaces should feel technical, code-driven, and mysterious. Avoid generic soft SaaS aesthetics.
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Use a subtle repeating-linear-gradient overlay on the hero section to mimic a CRT or holographic terminal.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(0,255,65,0.4)] on active icons and key matrix-green elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use strict 1px solid borders. Do not use soft, wide drop-shadows. Use hairline #1F2937 borders to separate content.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle grain (noise) in the global background to kill digital flatness.

buttons.primary: Sharp edges (rounded-sm max), solid #00FF41 background, black text. Hover: slightly brighter, scale up very subtly.
buttons.secondary: Transparent background, 1px solid #1F2937 border, text #F3F4F6. Hover: border #00FF41, text #00FF41.
buttons.more_ai_tools: Prominent placement throughout the app. Should stand out, perhaps using a glowing border or terminal-style chevron (e.g., '> MORE AI TOOLS_'). Link MUST open 'https://aiwebtools.app' in a new tab.

cards.base: Flat solid surfaces (#0C0C0C), 1px subtle border (#1F2937). No shadow.
cards.hover: Border transitions to #00FF41 or rgba(0,255,65,0.5). Slight lift (-translate-y-1).
cards.suite_cards: Grid based, displaying the suite icon, name, and count of bots. Use high density bento-style grids.

inputs_and_chat.chat_bubble_bot: Transparent background, distinct left-border (2px solid #00FF41), padding on left, text-primary.
inputs_and_chat.composer: Bottom-fixed or sticky, thick dark background, 1px border. Model selector should be a custom dropdown, not a native <select>.

headers_and_nav.base: Solid #050505 background or heavy backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/80. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds.

layouts.dashboard: Dense and highly functional. Left sidebar for navigation (Explore, Favorites, Recent, History, Admin). Center area for dynamic content (Suites Grid, Bots Grid).
layouts.bot_workspace: Three-pane layout. Left: Conversation History. Center: Main Chat interface (streaming text, markdown). Right: Bot details/capabilities and configuration (model selector, memory settings). Collapsible sidebars.
layouts.grids: Use CSS Grid aggressively. For Suite and Bot cards, use responsive grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.

motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition-colors duration-150. Do not use 'transition-all'.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for grid items. Use framer-motion if possible.
motion.chat_streaming: Cursor blinking effect at the end of the streaming response (a green block cursor '█').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the green (#00FF41) against black/dark-grey meets WCAG AA standards. If text on green, text must be black.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs, dropdowns) MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute in kebab-case.

media.icons: Use lucide-react or Phosphor Icons (regular or bold weight) for a sharp, technical look. Avoid playful/rounded icons.
media.3d_libraries: Optional: Use tsParticles for a subtle falling 'digital rain' or constellation node network in the hero section.

hero_background.description: Abstract green digital pattern with vertical lines
hero_background.placement: Landing page hero background (needs heavy black overlay, bg-black/80)

suite_abstract_1.description: A green circular object with a black background

suite_abstract_2.description: Abstract green and blue geometric shapes on black background

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Matrix Theme: dark mode only, deep void backgrounds (#050505), and neon green accents (#00FF41).
Avoid generic SaaS looks. Do not use gradients unless it's a subtle background glow.
Implement the 'MORE AI TOOLS' button prominently in headers and sidebars, linking to 'https://aiwebtools.app' with target='_blank'.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them: remove rounded corners (use rounded-none or rounded-sm), change borders to hard 1px #1F2937, and adjust focus rings to neon green.
The Bot Workspace MUST feel like a pro terminal: markdown support, syntax highlighting for code blocks, and a clean, dense layout.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive. The 3-pane Bot Workspace should elegantly collapse on mobile (e.g., sidebars hide behind hamburger menus or tabs).
Do not use transparent headers over scrolling content. Always use a solid background or a heavy backdrop blur.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center to the root App class.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.js or similar.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Adopt 'Optical Alignment' over strict mathematical alignment for varied shapes (like icons next to text).
Ensure empty states tell a story instead of just showing 'No data'.
Error messages should be human-readable, context-aware, and provide a clear recovery path.
Forms should validate inline and gracefully guide the user to resolution.
